n = int(input())
data = input()

import re

regex = r"\([\w_]*\)"
split_parts = re.split(regex, data)

max_word_length = 0
for part in split_parts:
    max_in_part = max((len(s) for s in part.split('_')), default=0)
    if max_in_part > max_word_length:
        max_word_length = max_in_part

pattern = re.compile(regex)
inside_words_count = 0
for match in pattern.finditer(data):
    inside = match.group()[1:-1]
    inside_words_count += sum(1 for s in inside.split('_') if s)

print(f"{max_word_length} {inside_words_count}")
